name: Unison double
desc: Same-pitch double detuned 8 cents with slow pitch and timing drift: a double-tracked vocal live

refs.why: double-tracked lead vocals, the sound live doubling imitates

notes: Humanize 60 % (±8 ct, ±10 ms drift) keeps the double from combing with the lead; fine 8 ct thickens without sounding out of tune
